However, the provided manuscript excerpt does not include any explicit stereotactic coordinates (x,y,z) for patient-versus-control structural contrasts in the main text or tables shown here. Although tables are referenced (Table A/B) that likely contain local maxima, no coordinates are present in the supplied full text; therefore I4 is not satisfied and per E6 the study must be excluded.

Although the study performed whole-brain VBM and TBSS analyses and clearly states laterality (left vs right MTLE), the manuscript does not present stereotactic coordinates for a grey-matter (structural VBM) patient-versus-control contrast in the provided full text. The reported stereotactic information and MNI reference appear to apply to DTI/TBSS localization (diffusion measures). The meta-analysis requires coordinates for structural (grey-matter) contrasts; here coordinates are only tied to diffusion measures, so inclusion criterion I4 is not met and exclusion criterion E7 applies. I5 (seizure-focus side determinable) and I6 (whole-brain analyses) are satisfied. Full text appears complete (supplementary tables not required), so fulltext_incomplete=false.

This study does not report stereotactic (MNI or Talairach) coordinates for any patient-versus-control structural contrast. It is a PET (F-FDG) metabolic imaging study using radiomics and a Siamese CNN for focus localization; while foci were manually delineated and seizure-focus laterality is determinable from labels, no standard-space coordinate tables or peak coordinates are provided. Inclusion criteria met: I5 (seizure-focus side is determinable via manual delineation) and I6 (whole-brain/whole-region PET analyses rather than ROI-only hippocampal volumetry). Inclusion criterion not met: I4 (no stereotactic coordinates reported). Exclusion criteria met: E6 (no stereotactic coordinates reported anywhere). Because I4 is not satisfied and E6 applies, the study must be excluded for the meta-analysis objective.

Therefore the study must be excluded because it fails to report stereotactic coordinates required for inclusion.

No exclusion criteria are met: coordinates are present, they refer to gray/white matter structural VBM results (not functional/diffusion), and the patient sample is TLE-specific. Full text appears complete (includes introduction, methods, results, discussion). Therefore the study should be INCLUDED.
